description: Formal rules for type inheritance between Factors, including resonance propagation, namespace alignment, and constraint monotonicity.

namespace_alignment.rule: The namespace path must correspond to the inheritance hierarchy
namespace_alignment.validation: depth = number of '/' characters in namespace

resonance_inheritance.description: How resonance parameters propagate through type hierarchy

rules.interface_to_interface: Child interface may increase n or m but cannot decrease them
rules.interface_to_instance: Instance may adjust phase offsets but must preserve n and m
rules.multiple_inheritance: Instance's (n,m) must be ≥ max of all implemented interfaces' (n,m)

phase_offset_propagation.rule: Phase offsets in nodes are additive along inheritance chain, modulo 2π
phase_offset_propagation.closure: Sum of phase offsets around any closed cycle in the child must be 0 mod 2π (inherited + new)

substrate_to_interface.rule: Interface must preserve topological invariants while adding type signatures and fixing resonance. Node types interpret the abstract concept in the substrate; resonance adds harmonic context.

interface_to_interface.rule: Child node types must be subtypes of or mappable to parent node types; resonance may increase
constraints: n and m must be ≥ parent
Child may override phase mapping but must preserve phase closure

interface_to_instance.rule: Instance must provide concrete values satisfying all type constraints and resonance parameters
requirements: Each node's value must match its type signature
Resonance must be compatible with all interfaces
Phase offsets may vary but must sum appropriately

multiple_inheritance.description: An Instance may implement multiple Interfaces (Level‑1 paradigms)
multiple_inheritance.rule: Node values must satisfy all type constraints from all implemented Interfaces; resonance (n,m) must be ≥ max of all interfaces
multiple_inheritance.conflict_resolution: If Interfaces assign different types to the same node, the Instance must provide a value that satisfies all (intersection type); resonance phases must be compatible (sum of phase differences = 0 mod 2π)
multiple_inheritance.example: A Factor implementing both 'MythOS/Character' and 'NarrativeCharter/Protagonist' must have node values that satisfy both mappings.

transitivity.rule: If Factor A inherits from B and B inherits from C, then A inherits from C
transitivity.preservation: All topological invariants, type constraints, and resonance parameters propagate along the chain

monotonicity.rule: Inheritance adds constraints but never removes them; resonance parameters never decrease
monotonicity.consequence: A child Factor is at least as constrained and at least as resonant as its parent

variance.node_types: Covariant – child may specialize (narrow) node types
variance.resonance: Covariant – child may increase n or m
variance.phase_offsets: Contravariant – child may adjust offsets but must preserve closure

validation_checklist: All implemented interfaces have compatible type signatures?
Phase closure satisfied (sum around cycles = 0 mod 2π)?
No constraint weakened relative to parent?
